_README: Rows audit_cell_coverage.py is allowed to find unreachable, and WHY. Every entry is
a promise that the cells are dead ON PURPOSE. Two legitimate reasons only:
SITUATIONAL — the art needs a STATE (being hit, blocking, knocked down, on a wall)
that no button press can create, so an input sweep can never reach it.
SUPERSEDED  — a later, longer row from the owner's own boards replaced it, and the
old cells stay on the sheet because sheets are append-only and the
⛔ DO NOT ADD A ROW HERE TO SILENCE THE TOOL. If art has no input, give it an input or
take the cells off the sheet. An allowlist that grows every time the gate goes red is
the gate failing, quietly, which is the exact failure this tool was built to end.
